title: GIVING THE CIRCUS AN ADDRESS
passages: There was a quieter stretch online because I was building. I described a Shopify project that could bring wellness, movement, fashion, creative technology, and my own experiments into one place.

Modern Day Circus was taking shape as a place where these interests could live together. The programmer, the maker, the person training before dawn, the person learning to walk a runway: I was looking for a way to let all of them belong in the same story.

reflections.prompt: Which parts of your life want to meet each other?
List three interests you usually keep separate. Sketch a place or project where they could meet.
Give your three interests a shared page: write a name, sketch a corner, or make a small outline.
